name: LIT-RAGBench
description: LIT-RAGBench is a benchmark for evaluating generator capabilities of large language models in retrieval-augmented generation, covering integration, reasoning, logic, table interpretation, and abstention, with human-constructed questions and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring.
reputation: A very recent arXiv benchmark with emerging interest in RAG evaluation, but not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Includes Japanese and English versions; uses fictional entities; enables detailed category-wise evaluation.
